# 用户关系系统关注功能实现 (2026-03-06 00:57Z)

_**User**_

用户关系系统：实现关注功能，采用一主多从+事件驱动模型。粉丝表，计数系统，列表缓存都作为关注表的伪从。关注事件发生时，在同一事务中插入关注表和 Outbox 表，使用 Canal 订阅 Outbox 表的 binlog，并将变更事件发布到Kafka 异步更新其他数据源
这是我的亮点描述，用户关系系统的具体链路是怎么样的？redis中有zset吗？是干嘛的，计数系统中的sds记录了某一个用户的粉丝数关注数，重建的话是基于关注表、粉丝表是吗

          {
            "text": "# 知光APP用户关系模块技术方案",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 一、概述",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "本方案旨在为知光APP实现高性能、高一致性、可扩展的用户关系模块，核心功能包括：",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "- 关注与取关操作",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "- 关注数与粉丝数统计",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "- 关注列表与粉丝列表查询",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "- 用户关系查询（是否互相关注）",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "方案目标是在高并发场景下保持一致性与高性能读写，采用数据库+Redis+异步消费者的混合架构，并辅以伪从同步与令牌桶限流机制。",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "## 二、系统设计架构",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "整体架构由以下几部分组成：",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- **主存储层（MySQL）**：存储关注关系，following表为主，follower表为伪从。",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- **缓存层（Redis）**：负责计数缓存、列表缓存、关系查询缓存及限流令牌桶。",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- **异步事件层（Kafka）**：消费关注事件、同步伪从、更新计数与缓存。",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- **消费者服务**：计数服务与缓存更新服务分别作为following表的伪从，订阅关注事件。",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 用户关系模块 API 接口文档",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 概述",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "- 模块路径前缀：&#96;/api/v1/relation&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "- 认证方式：所有接口需携带 &#96;Authorization: Bearer &lt;JWT&gt;&#96;。",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "- 返回格式：成功时返回布尔值或列表/对象；认证失败返回 &#96;401&#96;。",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "- 列表接口统一返回 &#96;ProfileResponse[]&#96;（含头像、昵称等用户信息）。",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 接口列表",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. 发起关注",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "- 方法：&#96;POST&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "- 路径：&#96;/api/v1/relation/follow&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- 查询参数：",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;toUserId&#96; &#96;long&#96; 被关注的用户 ID（必填）",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "- 响应：&#96;boolean&#96;，&#96;true&#96; 表示关注成功，&#96;false&#96; 表示被限流或未成功。",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "- 说明：接口内含令牌桶限流（按发起者维度），并通过 Outbox 触发异步缓存与粉丝表更新。",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- 示例：",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;curl -X POST \"https://host/api/v1/relation/follow?toUserId=123\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer &lt;token&gt;\"&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. 取消关注",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- 方法：&#96;POST&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- 路径：&#96;/api/v1/relation/unfollow&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- 查询参数：",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;toUserId&#96; &#96;long&#96; 被取消关注的用户 ID（必填）",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- 响应：&#96;boolean&#96;，&#96;true&#96; 表示取消成功。",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- 说明：通过 Outbox 触发异步缓存清理与粉丝表关系更新。",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- 示例：",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;curl -X POST \"https://host/api/v1/relation/unfollow?toUserId=123\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer &lt;token&gt;\"&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "### 3. 关系三态查询",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "- 方法：&#96;GET&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "- 路径：&#96;/api/v1/relation/status&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- 查询参数：",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;toUserId&#96; &#96;long&#96; 目标用户 ID（必填）",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "- 响应：&#96;object&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;following&#96; &#96;boolean&#96; 我是否关注 TA",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;followedBy&#96; &#96;boolean&#96; TA 是否关注我",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;mutual&#96; &#96;boolean&#96; 是否互相关注",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- 示例：",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;curl \"https://host/api/v1/relation/status?toUserId=123\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer &lt;token&gt;\"&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 响应示例：&#96;{\"following\":true,\"followedBy\":false,\"mutual\":false}&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4. 关注列表（偏移/游标分页二选一）",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "- 方法：&#96;GET&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "- 路径：&#96;/api/v1/relation/following&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "- 查询参数：",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;userId&#96; &#96;long&#96; 用户 ID（必填）",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;limit&#96; &#96;int&#96; 返回数量上限，范围 &#96;1-100&#96;，默认 &#96;20&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 49
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.549347460269928
    },
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\src\\main\\java\\com\\tongji\\relation\\service\\impl\\RelationServiceImpl.java",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 110,
            "column": 7
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 150,
            "column": 27
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "    @Override",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "    @Transactional",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "    public boolean follow(long fromUserId, long toUserId) {",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "        // Lua 脚本令牌桶限流",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 构建令牌桶 Key ；令牌桶大小：100 ；令牌生成速率：每秒 1 个",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "text": "        Long ok = redis.execute(tokenScript, List.of(\"rl:follow:\" + fromUserId), \"100\", \"1\");",
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "        if (ok == 0L) {",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "            return false;",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 生成一个随机的长整型 ID 作为关注表的主键 ID",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "        long id = ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextLong(Long.MAX_VALUE);",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 操作持久层，添加关注关系",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "        int inserted = mapper.insertFollowing(id, fromUserId, toUserId, 1);",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "        if (inserted &gt; 0) {",
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "text": "            try {",
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "                // 生成一个随机的长整型 ID 作为 outbox 收件箱表的主键 ID",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "text": "                Long outId = ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextLong(Long.MAX_VALUE);",
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "                String payload = objectMapper.writeValueAsString(new RelationEvent(\"FollowCreated\", fromUserId, toUserId, id));",
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "                // 将事件写入 outbox 表",
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "                outboxMapper.insert(outId, \"following\", id, \"FollowCreated\", payload);",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "            } catch (Exception ignored) {}",
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "text": "            // 插入成功返回 true",
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "text": "            return true;",
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 插入失败返回 false",
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "text": "        return false;",
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "text": "    /**",
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "     * 取消关注操作，并写入 Outbox 事件",
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "text": "     * @param fromUserId 发起取消关注的用户ID",
            "lineNumber": 145
          },
          {
            "text": "     * @param toUserId 被取消关注的用户ID",
            "lineNumber": 146
          },
          {
            "text": "     * @return 是否取消成功",
            "lineNumber": 147
          },
          {
            "text": "     */",
            "lineNumber": 148
          },
          {
            "text": "    @Override",
            "lineNumber": 149
          },
          {
            "text": "    @Transactional",
            "lineNumber": 150
          },
          {
            "text": "    public boolean unfollow",
            "lineNumber": 151
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.5425586700439453
    },

          {

            "lineNumber": 325

            "text": "    public List&lt;Long&gt; followers(long userId, int limit, int offset) {",

          },

          },

          },

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "text": "    /**",
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "text": "     * 查询双方关系状态",
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "text": "     * @param userId 当前用户ID",
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "text": "     * @param otherUserId 对方用户ID",

          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 221
          },
          {
            "text": "    @Override",
            "lineNumber": 222
          },
          {
            "text": "    public Map&lt;String, Boolean&gt; relationStatus(long userId, long otherUserId) {",
            "lineNumber": 223
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 判断当前用户是否关注对方用户",
            "lineNumber": 224
          },
          {
            "text": "        boolean following = isFollowing(userId, otherUserId);",

          },

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 230
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 返回含状态的结果 Map",

          },
          {
            "text": "        Map&lt;String, Boolean&gt; m = new LinkedHashMap&lt;&gt;();",

          },
          {

          },

          },

            "lineNumber": 235
          },
          {
            "text": "        return m;",

          },

          {

          },

          {

          },

          },

          },

          },
          {

          }
        ]

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\src\\main\\java\\com\\tongji\\relation\\processor\\RelationEventProcessor.java",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 37,
            "column": 7
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 64,
            "column": 33
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "    public void process(RelationEvent evt) {",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 基于事件相关参数构建去重键",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "        String dk = \"dedup:rel:\" + evt.type() + \":\" + evt.fromUserId() + \":\" + evt.toUserId() + \":\" + (evt.id() == null ? \"0\" : String.valueOf(evt.id()));",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "        Boolean first = redis.opsForValue().setIfAbsent(dk, \"1\", Duration.ofMinutes(10));",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 非首次（存在去重键）直接返回，保证消息幂等",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "        if (first == null || !first) {",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "            return;",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 基于事件类型执行相应的操作",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "        if (\"FollowCreated\".equals(evt.type())) {",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "            // 异步插入粉丝表",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "            mapper.insertFollower(evt.id(), evt.toUserId(), evt.fromUserId(), 1);",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "            long now = System.currentTimeMillis();",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "            // 更新关注表与粉丝表缓存：ZSet 按时间分数维护最近项，设置短 TTL 减少陈旧数据",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "            redis.opsForZSet().add(\"uf:flws:\" + evt.fromUserId(), String.valueOf(evt.toUserId()), now); // 对关注列表进行操作",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "            redis.opsForZSet().add(\"uf:fans:\" + evt.toUserId(), String.valueOf(evt.fromUserId()), now); // 对粉丝列表进行操作",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "            redis.expire(\"uf:flws:\" + evt.fromUserId(), Duration.ofHours(2)); // TTL 设置两小时",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "            redis.expire(\"uf:fans:\" + evt.toUserId(), Duration.ofHours(2)); // TTL 设置两小时",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "            // 更新关注数与粉丝数",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "            userCounterService.incrementFollowings(evt.fromUserId(), 1);",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "            userCounterService.incrementFollowers(evt.toUserId(), 1);",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "        } else if (\"FollowCanceled\".equals(evt.type())) {",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "            // 异步更新粉丝表",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "            mapper.cancelFollower",
            "lineNumber": 65
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.5164170861244202

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\用户关系设计方案.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 58
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 125,
            "column": 2
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "### 3.2 索引策略",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "- 使用联合索引 &#96;from_user_id + created_at&#96; 和 &#96;to_user_id + created_at&#96; 以支持分页查询。",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "- 覆盖索引减少回表，提升查询性能。",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "- 针对关系判定建立唯一索引避免重复关注。",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "## 四、伪从同步机制",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4.1 实现方式",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "- following表作为主表，follower表通过伪从消费其Binlog或消息事件实现同步。",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "- 同步逻辑：",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;FollowCreated&#96; → 插入 follower 记录",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;FollowCanceled&#96; → 更新 rel_status=0 或删除记录",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "- 幂等保证：以 &#96;(from_user_id,to_user_id)&#96; 作为唯一键去重。",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4.2 Outbox + 消费者机制（推荐）",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "- 在following表事务中插入Outbox记录。",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "- CDC组件（Canal/Debezium）或自研消费者监听Outbox并发送MQ事件。",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "- follower表、计数服务、缓存服务均从MQ订阅更新。",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "## 五、计数模块设计",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5.1 数据结构",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "- 使用Redis **SDS二进制结构**实现紧凑存储。",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "- Key：&#96;ucnt:{userId}&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "- Value：5个Int5字段，分别表示：",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "  1. 关注数",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "  2. 粉丝数",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "  3. 用户作品数",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "  4. 用户点赞作品数",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "  5. 用户收藏作品数",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5.2 同步机制",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "- 消费 &#96;FollowCreated/FollowCanceled&#96; 事件自动更新计数。",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "- Redis Lua脚本原子自增/自减。",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "- 定期对账任务比对数据库计数差异并修正。",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "## 六、缓存设计",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "### 6.1 列表缓存",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "- 关注列表：&#96;uf:flws:{userId}&#96; → ZSet(to_user_id, created_at)",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "- 粉丝列表：&#96;uf:fans:{userId}&#96; → ZSet(from_user_id, created_at)",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "- 仅缓存最近N条记录（如1000条）。",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "- 大V用户（粉丝&gt;50W）使用本地Caffeine缓存保存Top 500。",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "### 6.2 一致性更新",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "- 消费事件异步更新ZSet缓存：",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;FollowCreated&#96; → &#96;ZADD&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;FollowCanceled&#96; → &#96;ZREM&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "- 当缓存不存在时，DB分页查询并回填Redis。",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "### 6.3 Key TTL",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "- 列表缓存TTL：1~6小时。",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "- 计数缓存：永久存储，由事件维护。",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "## 七、限流设计",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "### 7.1 令牌桶算法",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "- 每个用户关注操作独立令牌桶：&#96;rl:follow:{userId}&#96;。",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "- 容量100，填充速率1/s。",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "- 使用Lua脚本原子取令牌：",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "  ",
            "lineNumber": 126
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.4981417953968048
    },

          },

            "lineNumber": 154

            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "text": "                Long outId = ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextLong(Long.MAX_VALUE);",
            "lineNumber": 158
          },
          {
            "text": "                // 取消关注，payload 中无需传入关注表中的主键 ID",
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "text": "                String payload = objectMapper.writeValueAsString(new RelationEvent(\"FollowCanceled\", fromUserId, toUserId, null));",
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "text": "                outboxMapper.insert(outId, \"following\", null, \"FollowCanceled\", payload);",
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "text": "            } catch (Exception ignored) {}",
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "text": "            return true;",
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "text": "        return false;",
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {

          },

            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "text": "    /**",
            "lineNumber": 169

          },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\用户关系设计方案.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 122
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 159,
            "column": 3
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "- 每个用户关注操作独立令牌桶：&#96;rl:follow:{userId}&#96;。",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "- 容量100，填充速率1/s。",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "- 使用Lua脚本原子取令牌：",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 当桶为空时拒绝请求，防止短时间恶意关注。",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "## 八、接口设计",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "| 功能 | 接口 | 方法 | 说明 |",
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "|------|------|------|------|",
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "| 关注 | /relation/follow | POST | 幂等，写following并发事件 |",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "| 取关 | /relation/unfollow | POST | 更新rel_status=0 |",
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "text": "| 查询关系 | /relation/status | GET | 判断是否互关 |",
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "text": "| 关注列表 | /relation/following | GET | 支持游标分页 |",
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "| 粉丝列表 | /relation/followers | GET | 支持游标分页 |",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "text": "| 计数查询 | /relation/counter | GET | Redis直读 |",
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "## 九、系统一致性与补偿机制",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "| 模块 | 一致性方式 | 说明 |",
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "text": "|-------|-------------|------|",
            "lineNumber": 145
          },
          {
            "text": "| following→follower | 异步最终一致 | 通过Outbox+MQ同步 |",
            "lineNumber": 146
          },
          {
            "text": "| following→计数 | 异步最终一致 | 事件驱动更新Redis |",
            "lineNumber": 147
          },
          {
            "text": "| following→缓存 | 异步更新 | 通过MQ推送ZSet操作 |",
            "lineNumber": 148
          },
          {
            "text": "| Redis计数→DB | 离线校对 | 每日对账修复 |",
            "lineNumber": 149
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 150
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 151
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 152
          },
          {
            "text": "## 十、异常与恢复机制",
            "lineNumber": 153
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 154
          },
          {
            "text": "- **事件幂等**：事件ID+用户ID作为幂等键。",
            "lineNumber": 155
          },
          {
            "text": "- **延迟容忍**：客户端显示乐观更新，后端异步补偿。",
            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Redis容灾**：AOF everysec，多副本部署；每日计数快照备份。",
            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "text": "- **冷备回放**：MQ消息保留14天，可重放恢复。",
            "lineNumber": 158
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 160
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.4847281873226166
    },

      "codeBlock": {

        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "- 路径：&#96;/api/v1/relation/following&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "- 查询参数：",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;userId&#96; &#96;long&#96; 用户 ID（必填）",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;limit&#96; &#96;int&#96; 返回数量上限，范围 &#96;1-100&#96;，默认 &#96;20&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;offset&#96; &#96;int&#96; 偏移量，默认 &#96;0&#96;（当未传 &#96;cursor&#96; 时生效）",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;cursor&#96; &#96;long&#96; 游标（毫秒时间戳，上一页最后一条的创建时间；传入则走游标分页）",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "- 响应：&#96;ProfileResponse[]&#96; 关注的用户信息列表（倒序）。",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "- 说明：",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 未传 &#96;cursor&#96; 时使用偏移分页；传 &#96;cursor&#96; 时按游标分页。",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 游标值为上一页最后一条关系的 &#96;created_at&#96; 毫秒时间戳；当前接口不返回游标值，需客户端自行维护或上层配合提供。",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "- 示例：",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 偏移分页：&#96;curl \"https://host/api/v1/relation/following?userId=100&amp;limit=20&amp;offset=0\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer &lt;token&gt;\"&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 游标分页：&#96;curl \"https://host/api/v1/relation/following?userId=100&amp;limit=20&amp;cursor=1731480000000\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer &lt;token&gt;\"&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 响应示例：",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "    &#96;&#96;&#96;json",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "    [",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "      {",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"id\": 123,",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"nickname\": \"张三\",",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"avatar\": \"https://cdn/avatars/123.png\",",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"bio\": \"热爱分享\",",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"zgId\": \"zg_123\",",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"gender\": \"male\",",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"birthday\": \"1995-01-01\",",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"school\": \"Tongji\",",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"phone\": \"\",",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"email\": \"\",",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "        \"tagJson\": \"{\\\"领域\\\":\\\"AI\\\"}\"",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "      }",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "    ]",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "    &#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5. 粉丝列表（偏移/游标分页二选一）",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "- 方法：&#96;GET&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "- 路径：&#96;/api/v1/relation/followers&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "- 查询参数：",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;userId&#96; &#96;long&#96; 用户 ID（必填）",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;limit&#96; &#96;int&#96; 返回数量上限，范围 &#96;1-100&#96;，默认 &#96;20&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;offset&#96; &#96;int&#96; 偏移量，默认 &#96;0&#96;（当未传 &#96;cursor&#96; 时生效）",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;cursor&#96; &#96;long&#96; 游标（毫秒时间戳，上一页最后一条的创建时间；传入则走游标分页）",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "- 响应：&#96;ProfileResponse[]&#96; 粉丝用户信息列表（倒序）。",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "- 示例：",
            "lineNumber": 87

          {
            "text": "  - &#96;curl \"https://host/api/v1/relation/followers?userId=100&amp;limit=20&amp;offset=0\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer &lt;token&gt;\"&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 88
          }
        ]

          },

          },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\用户关系设计方案.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 122
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 159,
            "column": 3
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "- 每个用户关注操作独立令牌桶：&#96;rl:follow:{userId}&#96;。",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "- 容量100，填充速率1/s。",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "- 使用Lua脚本原子取令牌：",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 当桶为空时拒绝请求，防止短时间恶意关注。",
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "## 八、接口设计",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "| 功能 | 接口 | 方法 | 说明 |",
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "|------|------|------|------|",
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "| 关注 | /relation/follow | POST | 幂等，写following并发事件 |",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "| 取关 | /relation/unfollow | POST | 更新rel_status=0 |",
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "text": "| 查询关系 | /relation/status | GET | 判断是否互关 |",
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "text": "| 关注列表 | /relation/following | GET | 支持游标分页 |",
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "text": "| 粉丝列表 | /relation/followers | GET | 支持游标分页 |",
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "text": "| 计数查询 | /relation/counter | GET | Redis直读 |",
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "## 九、系统一致性与补偿机制",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "| 模块 | 一致性方式 | 说明 |",
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "text": "|-------|-------------|------|",
            "lineNumber": 145
          },
          {
            "text": "| following→follower | 异步最终一致 | 通过Outbox+MQ同步 |",
            "lineNumber": 146
          },
          {
            "text": "| following→计数 | 异步最终一致 | 事件驱动更新Redis |",
            "lineNumber": 147
          },
          {
            "text": "| following→缓存 | 异步更新 | 通过MQ推送ZSet操作 |",
            "lineNumber": 148
          },
          {
            "text": "| Redis计数→DB | 离线校对 | 每日对账修复 |",
            "lineNumber": 149
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 150
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 151
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 152
          },
          {
            "text": "## 十、异常与恢复机制",
            "lineNumber": 153
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 154
          },
          {
            "text": "- **事件幂等**：事件ID+用户ID作为幂等键。",
            "lineNumber": 155
          },
          {
            "text": "- **延迟容忍**：客户端显示乐观更新，后端异步补偿。",
            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Redis容灾**：AOF everysec，多副本部署；每日计数快照备份。",
            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "text": "- **冷备回放**：MQ消息保留14天，可重放恢复。",
            "lineNumber": 158
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 160
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.3387888967990875
    },

            "text": "    @KafkaListener(topics = CounterTopics.EVENTS, groupId = \"counter-agg\")",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "    public void onMessage(String message, Acknowledgment ack) throws Exception {",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 读取队列中的事件，JSON 转换回 Java 计数事件对象",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "        CounterEvent evt = objectMapper.readValue(message, CounterEvent.class);",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 基于实体事件类型 + 实体事件 ID 构建对应聚合桶的 Key",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "        String aggKey = CounterKeys.aggKey(evt.getEntityType(), evt.getEntityId());",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "        // like / fav 对应的 indexId ： like 1 、fav 2",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "        String field = String.valueOf(evt.getIdx());",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "        try {",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "            // 将增量持久化到 Redis Hash 中对应的 field 中，like 1 、fav 2",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "            redis.opsForHash().increment(aggKey, field, evt.getDelta());",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "            // 成功后提交位点，绑定“已持久化”语义",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "            ack.acknowledge();",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "        } catch (Exception ex) {",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "            // 不提交位点以便重试",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "    /**",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "     * 将聚合增量刷写到 SDS 固定结构计数",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "     * 固定延迟 1s，保证秒级最终一致性 TODO 是如何保证的",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "     * Spring框架的定时任务注解",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "     * 方法每执行完一次后，延迟 1000 毫秒（1秒）再执行下一次，确保每次执行之间有 1 秒间隔",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "     * fixedDelay：上次任务结束时间到下次任务开始时间的固定间隔",

          },
          {
            "text": "     * 单位：毫秒（1000L表示1000毫秒）",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "     */",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "    @Scheduled(fixedDelay = 1000L)",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "    public void flush()",

          }

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\计数系统设计方案.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},

        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 计数系统设计方案（位图 + 事件聚合 + SDS）",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## 1. 目标与边界",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "- 统一支持内容实体的点赞、收藏等高并发计数；用户维度支持关注、粉丝、发文、获赞、获收藏。",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "- 写入需幂等、读低延迟、整体秒级最终一致；遇到异常可自动重建，保证数据纠偏能力。",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "- 成本与性能平衡：以内存占用低、CPU 分布均衡为目标，避免数据库热写与 Redis 哈希膨胀。",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "## 2. 架构总览",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "- 写路径（状态事实为位图，增量事件异步折叠到汇总）：",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 位图切换（Lua 原子 &#96;SETBIT&#96;）→ 仅在状态变化时产出计数事件 → Kafka &#96;counter-events&#96; → 聚合桶（Redis Hash）持久化增量 → 定时刷写到 SDS 固定结构计数。",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- 读路径（优先读汇总，异常时回溯事实）：",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 常规读：直接读取 SDS 固定结构计数",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 异常读：SDS 缺失或结构异常时，用位图分片 &#96;BITCOUNT&#96; 真实重建；分布式锁保护并清理对应聚合字段，避免重复加算。",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- 用户维度计数通过关系 Outbox 事件处理器异步维护，并提供按需重建与抽样校验。",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "用户动作 → 位图切换(原子) → 计数事件 → Kafka",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "                                     ↓",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "                                聚合增量桶(Hash) ← 手动位点确认",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "                                     ↓ (fixedDelay=1s)",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "                             刷写到汇总(SDS) ← 原子 Lua 更新",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "读取计数：优先 SDS；异常：位图重建 + 分布式锁 + 清理聚合字段",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "核心代码参考：",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- 位图切换与事件产出：&#96;src/main/java/com/tongji/counter/service/impl/CounterServiceImpl.java:61-75&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- 聚合增量消费与刷写：",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "  - Kafka 增量入桶：&#96;src/main/java/com/tongji/counter/event/CounterAggregationConsumer.java:33-46&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 定时刷写到 SDS：&#96;src/main/java/com/tongji/counter/event/CounterAggregationConsumer.java:48-104&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "- 读路径与异常重建：&#96;src/main/java/com/tongji/counter/service/impl/CounterServiceImpl.java:77-125&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "- 用户维度异步维护：&#96;src/main/java/com/tongji/relation/processor/RelationEventProcessor.java:44-58&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 32
          }
        ]
      },

      "codeBlock": {

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "### 3.2 索引策略",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "- 使用联合索引 &#96;from_user_id + created_at&#96; 和 &#96;to_user_id + created_at&#96; 以支持分页查询。",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "- 覆盖索引减少回表，提升查询性能。",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "- 针对关系判定建立唯一索引避免重复关注。",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "## 四、伪从同步机制",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4.1 实现方式",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "- following表作为主表，follower表通过伪从消费其Binlog或消息事件实现同步。",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "- 同步逻辑：",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;FollowCreated&#96; → 插入 follower 记录",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;FollowCanceled&#96; → 更新 rel_status=0 或删除记录",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "- 幂等保证：以 &#96;(from_user_id,to_user_id)&#96; 作为唯一键去重。",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4.2 Outbox + 消费者机制（推荐）",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "- 在following表事务中插入Outbox记录。",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "- CDC组件（Canal/Debezium）或自研消费者监听Outbox并发送MQ事件。",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "- follower表、计数服务、缓存服务均从MQ订阅更新。",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "## 五、计数模块设计",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5.1 数据结构",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "- 使用Redis **SDS二进制结构**实现紧凑存储。",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "- Key：&#96;ucnt:{userId}&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "- Value：5个Int5字段，分别表示：",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "  1. 关注数",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "  2. 粉丝数",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "  3. 用户作品数",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "  4. 用户点赞作品数",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "  5. 用户收藏作品数",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5.2 同步机制",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "- 消费 &#96;FollowCreated/FollowCanceled&#96; 事件自动更新计数。",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "- Redis Lua脚本原子自增/自减。",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "- 定期对账任务比对数据库计数差异并修正。",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "## 六、缓存设计",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "### 6.1 列表缓存",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "- 关注列表：&#96;uf:flws:{userId}&#96; → ZSet(to_user_id, created_at)",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "- 粉丝列表：&#96;uf:fans:{userId}&#96; → ZSet(from_user_id, created_at)",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "- 仅缓存最近N条记录（如1000条）。",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "- 大V用户（粉丝&gt;50W）使用本地Caffeine缓存保存Top 500。",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "### 6.2 一致性更新",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "- 消费事件异步更新ZSet缓存：",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;FollowCreated&#96; → &#96;ZADD&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;FollowCanceled&#96; → &#96;ZREM&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "- 当缓存不存在时，DB分页查询并回填Redis。",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "### 6.3 Key TTL",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "- 列表缓存TTL：1~6小时。",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "- 计数缓存：永久存储，由事件维护。",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "## 七、限流设计",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "### 7.1 令牌桶算法",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "- 每个用户关注操作独立令牌桶：&#96;rl:follow:{userId}&#96;。",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "- 容量100，填充速率1/s。",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "- 使用Lua脚本原子取令牌：",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "  ",
            "lineNumber": 126
          }
        ]
      },

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\README.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# 知光平台-知识获取与分享社区",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "- **项目概述**：知识社区 APP（后续考虑支持付费），支持发布知识、点赞/收藏、关注取关、首页 Feed 展示与对象存储直传，AI 生成摘要等等。项目各模块进行了充分详细的设计以满足高并发和高可用需求。",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "- **技术栈**：后端 Java 21 + Spring Boot + Spring Security + Spring AI + RAG + MyBatis + MySQL + Redis + Kafka + Caffeine + 阿里云 OSS + Canal + Elasticsearch ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "- **项目细节与亮点**：",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "    - **认证系统**：开发基于 Spring Security 的 JWT 双令牌认证系统，采用 RS256 签名 + Redis 刷新令牌白名单，实现 15 分钟访问令牌 + 7 天刷新令牌的安全会话管理，支持即时令牌撤销，兼顾高安全与高性能。",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "    - **计数系统**：笔记维度(点赞收藏)与用户维度(关注取关) 以 Redis 作为底层存储系统，采用定制化 Redis SDS 二进制紧凑计数，使用 Lua 脚本进行原子更新，并实现了采样一致性校验与自愈重建。定制化 Redis SDS",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "    - **发布系统**：采用渐进式发布流程，发布的图片、视频，Markdown 文档等都存入 OSS 对象存储系统，采用后端发布预签名+前端直传的形式上传，节省前后端传输资源渐进式发布流程。并接入 DeepSeek AI 一键生成文章摘要。",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "    - **用户关系系统**：实现关注功能，采用一主多从+事件驱动模型。粉丝表，计数系统，列表缓存都作为关注表的伪从。关注事件发生时，在同一事务中插入关注表和 Outbox 表，使用 Canal 订阅 Outbox 表的 binlog，并将变更事件发布到 Kafka 异步更新其他数据源。Outbox 模式",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "    - **点赞系统**：采用异步写+写聚合Kafka 异步写+写聚合的形式应对高并发写场景。采用位图的结构高效实现幂等和判重。读取遇到异常或缺失时，基于位图做按需重建，保证最终一致。并用 Kafka 做“灾难回放”的兜底操作。分片位图+计数重建策略",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "    - **Feed 流**：采用三级缓存架构且设计了缓存一致性策略，本地 Caffeine + Redis 页面缓存 + Redis 片段缓存。自定义 hotkey 探测机制自定义 hotkey 探测，基于热点检测按层级延长缓存时长，叠加随机抖动抗雪崩。并设置单飞锁(single-flight)避免同一页并发回源风暴。Feed 三级缓存设计",
            "lineNumber": 10
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.31768476963043213
    },

            "text": "    public void process(RelationEvent evt) {",

          {
            "text": "        // 基于事件相关参数构建去重键",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "        String dk = \"dedup:rel:\" + evt.type() + \":\" + evt.fromUserId() + \":\" + evt.toUserId() + \":\" + (evt.id() == null ? \"0\" : String.valueOf(evt.id()));",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "        Boolean first = redis.opsForValue().setIfAbsent(dk, \"1\", Duration.ofMinutes(10));",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 非首次（存在去重键）直接返回，保证消息幂等",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "        if (first == null || !first) {",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "            return;",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 基于事件类型执行相应的操作",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "        if (\"FollowCreated\".equals(evt.type())) {",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "            // 异步插入粉丝表",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "            mapper.insertFollower(evt.id(), evt.toUserId(), evt.fromUserId(), 1);",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "            long now = System.currentTimeMillis();",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "            // 更新关注表与粉丝表缓存：ZSet 按时间分数维护最近项，设置短 TTL 减少陈旧数据",
            "lineNumber": 54

            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "        String dk = \"dedup:rel:\" + evt.type() + \":\" + evt.fromUserId() + \":\" + evt.toUserId() + \":\" + (evt.id() == null ? \"0\" : String.valueOf(evt.id()));",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },

          },

          },

          },
          {

          },

          },

          },
          {

          },

          },

          },

          },

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\docs\\用户关系设计方案.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 58
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 125,
            "column": 2
          }
        },
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "### 3.2 索引策略",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "- 使用联合索引 &#96;from_user_id + created_at&#96; 和 &#96;to_user_id + created_at&#96; 以支持分页查询。",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "- 覆盖索引减少回表，提升查询性能。",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "- 针对关系判定建立唯一索引避免重复关注。",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "## 四、伪从同步机制",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4.1 实现方式",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "- following表作为主表，follower表通过伪从消费其Binlog或消息事件实现同步。",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "- 同步逻辑：",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;FollowCreated&#96; → 插入 follower 记录",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;FollowCanceled&#96; → 更新 rel_status=0 或删除记录",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "- 幂等保证：以 &#96;(from_user_id,to_user_id)&#96; 作为唯一键去重。",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4.2 Outbox + 消费者机制（推荐）",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "- 在following表事务中插入Outbox记录。",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "- CDC组件（Canal/Debezium）或自研消费者监听Outbox并发送MQ事件。",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "- follower表、计数服务、缓存服务均从MQ订阅更新。",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "## 五、计数模块设计",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5.1 数据结构",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "- 使用Redis **SDS二进制结构**实现紧凑存储。",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "- Key：&#96;ucnt:{userId}&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "- Value：5个Int5字段，分别表示：",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "  1. 关注数",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "  2. 粉丝数",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "  3. 用户作品数",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "  4. 用户点赞作品数",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "  5. 用户收藏作品数",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "### 5.2 同步机制",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "- 消费 &#96;FollowCreated/FollowCanceled&#96; 事件自动更新计数。",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "- Redis Lua脚本原子自增/自减。",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "- 定期对账任务比对数据库计数差异并修正。",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "## 六、缓存设计",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "### 6.1 列表缓存",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "- 关注列表：&#96;uf:flws:{userId}&#96; → ZSet(to_user_id, created_at)",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "- 粉丝列表：&#96;uf:fans:{userId}&#96; → ZSet(from_user_id, created_at)",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "- 仅缓存最近N条记录（如1000条）。",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "- 大V用户（粉丝&gt;50W）使用本地Caffeine缓存保存Top 500。",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "### 6.2 一致性更新",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "- 消费事件异步更新ZSet缓存：",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;FollowCreated&#96; → &#96;ZADD&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;FollowCanceled&#96; → &#96;ZREM&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "- 当缓存不存在时，DB分页查询并回填Redis。",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "### 6.3 Key TTL",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "- 列表缓存TTL：1~6小时。",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "- 计数缓存：永久存储，由事件维护。",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "## 七、限流设计",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "text": "### 7.1 令牌桶算法",
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "- 每个用户关注操作独立令牌桶：&#96;rl:follow:{userId}&#96;。",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "- 容量100，填充速率1/s。",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "- 使用Lua脚本原子取令牌：",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "text": "  ",
            "lineNumber": 126
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.37201976776123047
    },

      "codeBlock": {

          {
            "text": "- 示例：",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;curl \"https://host/api/v1/relation/followers?userId=100&amp;limit=20&amp;offset=0\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer &lt;token&gt;\"&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "  - 响应示例参考上节 &#96;ProfileResponse&#96; 结构。",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "### 6. 用户计数查询（SDS 紧凑编码）",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "- 方法：&#96;GET&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "- 路径：&#96;/api/v1/relation/counter&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "- 查询参数：",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;userId&#96; &#96;long&#96; 用户 ID（必填）",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "- 响应：&#96;object&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;followings&#96; &#96;long&#96; 关注数",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;followers&#96; &#96;long&#96; 粉丝数",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;posts&#96; &#96;long&#96; 发帖数",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;likedPosts&#96; &#96;long&#96; 获得的点赞数（作者维度累计）",
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;favedPosts&#96; &#96;long&#96; 获得的收藏数（作者维度累计）",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "- 示例：",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;curl \"https://host/api/v1/relation/counter?userId=100\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer &lt;token&gt;\"&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "## 分页与缓存说明",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "- 偏移分页优先命中 Redis ZSet（倒序），未命中时回填 DB 并设置 TTL（2 小时）。",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "text": "- 游标分页基于 ZSet 分数（&#96;created_at&#96; 毫秒时间戳）进行 &#96;score&#96; 倒序范围查询。",
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "- 大 V 用户前几页列表可能命中本地 Caffeine 缓存以降低热点读压。",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "## 返回对象：ProfileResponse 字段",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;id&#96; &#96;long&#96; 用户ID",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;nickname&#96; &#96;string&#96; 昵称",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;avatar&#96; &#96;string&#96; 头像URL",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;bio&#96; &#96;string&#96; 个性签名",
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;zgId&#96; &#96;string&#96; 平台ID",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;gender&#96; &#96;string&#96; 性别",
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;birthday&#96; &#96;date&#96; 生日（&#96;YYYY-MM-DD&#96;）",
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;school&#96; &#96;string&#96; 学校",
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;phone&#96; &#96;string&#96; 手机",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;email&#96; &#96;string&#96; 邮箱",
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;tagJson&#96; &#96;string&#96; 标签JSON",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "## 认证与错误",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "- 未携带或无效 &#96;JWT&#96;：&#96;401 Unauthorized&#96;。",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "- 关注操作可能受限流影响（返回 &#96;false&#96;），请稍后重试。",
            "lineNumber": 125
          }
        ]
      },

          },
          {
            "text": "        boolean followedBy = isFollowing(otherUserId, userId);",

          },
          {
            "text": "        // 若均为 true ，那么即为互相关注",

          },
          {
            "text": "        m.put(\"mutual\", mutual);",

          },
          {
            "text": "        return m;",

            "text": "    @GetMapping(\"/counter\")",

          },
          {
            "text": "    public Map&lt;String, Long&gt; counter(@RequestParam(\"userId\") long userId) {",
            "lineNumber": 145
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 从 Redis 读取用户计数字符串（SDS，键：ucnt:{userId}），字节数组",
            "lineNumber": 146
          },
          {
            "text": "        byte[] raw = redis.execute((RedisCallback&lt;byte[]&gt;)",
            "lineNumber": 147
          },
          {
            "text": "                c -&gt; c.stringCommands().get((\"ucnt:\" + userId).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));",
            "lineNumber": 148
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 149
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 拼接计数结果",
            "lineNumber": 150
          },
          {
            "text": "        Map&lt;String, Long&gt; m = new LinkedHashMap&lt;&gt;();",
            "lineNumber": 151
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 152
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 缺失或结构异常（少于 5 段 × 每段 4 字节）时尝试重建",
            "lineNumber": 153
          },
          {
            "text": "        if (raw == null || raw.length &lt; 20) {",
            "lineNumber": 154
          },
          {
            "text": "            try {",
            "lineNumber": 155
          },
          {
            "text": "                userCounterService.rebuildAllCounters(userId);",
            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {
            "text": "            } catch (Exception ignored) {}",
            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 158
          },
          {
            "text": "            // 重建后二次读取",
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "text": "            raw = redis.execute((RedisCallback&lt;byte[]&gt;)",
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "text": "                    c -&gt; c.stringCommands().get((\"ucnt:\" + userId).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));",
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "text": "            // 仍失败，所有参数返回 0，保证接口可用性",
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {
            "text": "            if (raw == null || raw.length &lt; 20) {",
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "text": "                m.put(\"followings\", 0L);",
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "text": "                m.put(\"followers\", 0L);",
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "text": "                m.put(\"posts\", 0L);",
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "text": "                m.put(\"likedPosts\", 0L);",
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "text": "                m.put(\"favedPosts\", 0L);",
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "text": "                return m;",
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "text": "            }",
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "text": "        }",
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "text": "        final byte[] buf = raw;",
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 段数（每段 4 字节，按大端 32 位整型编码）",
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "text": "        final int seg = buf.length / 4;",
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 读取第 idx 段的计数（1 基坐标），大端拼接为 long",
            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "text": "        IntFunction&lt;Long&gt; read = idx -&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "text": "            if (idx &lt; 1 || idx &gt; seg) return 0L;",
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "text": "            // 偏移量",
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "text": "            int off = (idx - 1) * 4;",

          },

            "text": "            long n = 0;",

          },
          {
            "text": "            for (int i = 0; i &lt; 4; i++) {",
            "lineNumber": 184
          },
          {
            "text": "                n = (n &lt;&lt; 8) | (buf[off + i] &amp; 0xFFL);",

          },
          {
            "text": "            }",

          },
          {
            "text": "            return n;",

          },
          {
            "text": "        };",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 关注数",
            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {
            "text": "        long sdsFollowings = read.apply(1);",
            "lineNumber": 191
          },
          {
            "text": "        // 粉丝数",
            "lineNumber": 192
          },
          {

          },
